name: Arducam B0385: 1MP OV9782 global-shutter colour USB 2.0 UVC camera board with M12 low-distortion lens (board silkscreen 'Arducam UC-852 Rev.A')

related_cad_NOT_THIS_PART.why_not: Official Arducam/UCTRONICS STEP for the sibling SKU B0332 (mono OV9281). Its root product is 'B0418' and its board is 'UC-844_Rev.B'. That board takes the sensor on a flex through an FH26-33S 33-pin FPC connector, and its 4-pin connector is a B4B-ZR (top entry). The B0385 is a different PCB (UC-852 Rev.A in the photos) with a side-entry S4B-ZR connector (datasheet) and no FPC connector. It shares the 38x38 outline and the M12 holder/lens envelope, but the components differ. Do not render it as the B0385.

dims_mm.mounting_holes_outer: 4x on 34.00 x 34.00 pitch, labelled 'R=4* 1.30mm' (read as radius 1.30, i.e. Ø2.6)
dims_mm.mounting_holes_inner: 4x on 28.00 x 28.00 pitch, labelled 'R=4* 1.40mm' (read as radius 1.40, i.e. Ø2.8)
dims_mm.edge_slots: rounded routed slots run along all four edges between the holes (drawn, not dimensioned); in photos the slot edges are plated/gold
dims_mm.lens_centre: board centre (19.00 from the right edge and 19.00 from the top edge)
dims_mm.sensor_holder_footprint: square drawn around the lens centre, not dimensioned. The photos show a black M12 holder with two screw ears on the vertical axis
dims_mm.usb_connector: 4-pin JST ZR 1.5 mm pitch, S4B-ZR(LF)(SN) side-entry, on the back. Footprint box 7.56 wide x 3.81 deep, 8.24 from the left edge, 3.47 from the bottom edge. Pin order VCC, DM, DP, GND
dims_mm.lens: M27280M07S: M12 x P0.5 mount, EFL 2.8, F2.8, Ø14±0.05 head, total length 15.86 (head 4.3 + thread 8.9 = 13.2, the remaining ~2.7 is the rear IR-filter seat, Ø9 filter), Ø12 thread, IR-cut 650 filter, 4 g; lens spec table lists 'Lens Holder Height 7mm'
dims_mm.photo_dimension_note: the retailer/Arducam photo labels '32.00mm' under the board; the datasheet only gives 38/34/28 pitches. Trust the datasheet

colors.pcb: matte black solder mask, white silkscreen ('Arducam', 'UC-852', 'Rev.A' on the back; G S F pads and L/R footprints on the front)
colors.plating: gold (ENIG) annular rings on all 8 mounting holes and along the edge slot outlines; matches the gold rings in the team render
colors.lens_holder: black plastic M12 holder with two ear tabs
colors.lens: black anodised/plastic barrel with knurled ring; glass with a purple/green AR-coating sheen
colors.components: back: black QFP USB-bridge IC (Sonix; USB VID:PID 0c45:6366 per Arducam forum), small black ICs, tan/brown MLCCs, and two silver screw heads that fix the lens holder from behind

notes: The team render matches the B0385: black 38x38 board, gold rings, black M12 holder and lens. No public CAD exists for the B0385 / UC-852 board, so model it by hand from the datasheet drawing plus the front/back photos. The B0332 STEP can give general proportions for the M12 holder and lens envelope but is a different PCB. Some listings (welectron title) say 120 fps; Arducam's manual says MJPG 100 fps at 1280x800.
